name: synergy-taskboard
description: Kanban task board for humans and agents, inspired by dashi-taskboard (Linear-style workflow)

featuresSummary.title: task-list
featuresSummary.description: List tasks on the taskboard. Returns tasks with identifier, title, status, priority, labels, assignee, linked session count and version. Use this BEFORE creating or updating to avoid duplicates.

featuresSummary.title: task-get
featuresSummary.description: Get one task by its identifier (e.g. LOCAL-3) or id, including description, comments, linked session ids and focus session.

featuresSummary.title: task-create
featuresSummary.description: Create a task on the taskboard. The project defaults to 'local'. Returns the created task with its identifier and version.

featuresSummary.title: task-update
featuresSummary.description: Update a task. Requires the current `version` from task-list/task-get (optimistic concurrency). On VERSION_CONFLICT, re-read the task and retry.

featuresSummary.title: task-move
featuresSummary.description: Move a task to another status column. Typical workflow: todo -> in_progress (claim), in_progress -> in_review (done implementing, waiting for user acceptance), in_review -> done ONLY after the user explicitly confirms. Use blocked when stuck, canceled when abandoned.

featuresSummary.title: task-comment
featuresSummary.description: Add a comment to a task. Summarize what you changed, how you verified it, and remaining risks.

featuresSummary.title: task-link
featuresSummary.description: Link the current session to a task so the agent sees it in context. If the task has no focus session yet, this session becomes the focus. Idempotent.

featuresSummary.title: task-unlink
featuresSummary.description: Unlink the current session from a task. The task stays on the board.

featuresSummary.title: task-focus
featuresSummary.description: Make the current session the focus session of a task (must already be linked). The focus task is what gets injected into the system prompt.

featuresSummary.title: Packaged skills
featuresSummary.description: Provides 1 skill that agents can use when relevant.

featuresSummary.title: Conversation guidance
featuresSummary.description: Adds plugin guidance to conversations when the feature is active.

featuresSummary.title: project-create command
featuresSummary.description: Create a taskboard project

featuresSummary.title: project-list command
featuresSummary.description: List taskboard projects

featuresSummary.title: issue-create command
featuresSummary.description: Create a task on the taskboard

featuresSummary.title: issue-list command
featuresSummary.description: List tasks on the taskboard

featuresSummary.title: issue-get command
featuresSummary.description: Get one task by identifier or id, with comments

featuresSummary.title: issue-update command
featuresSummary.description: Update a task (requires --if-version for optimistic concurrency)

featuresSummary.title: issue-move command
featuresSummary.description: Move a task to another status (optimistic concurrency via --if-version)

featuresSummary.title: comment-add command
featuresSummary.description: Add a comment to a task

featuresSummary.title: Synergy interface extensions
featuresSummary.description: Adds 3 interface extensions.

permissionsSummary.title: Workspace read
permissionsSummary.description: Can use the declared Synergy access workspace.read.

permissionsSummary.title: Workspace write
permissionsSummary.description: Can use the declared Synergy access workspace.write.

permissionsSummary.title: Settings read
permissionsSummary.description: Can use the declared Synergy access settings.read.

permissionsSummary.title: Settings write
permissionsSummary.description: Can use the declared Synergy access settings.write.

permissionsSummary.title: Session read
permissionsSummary.description: Can use the declared Synergy access session.read.

permissionsSummary.title: Ui hostActions
permissionsSummary.description: Can use the declared Synergy access ui.hostActions.

versions.changelog: Session-aware taskboard: tasks link to sessions, agent system-prompt injection, loose-trigger auto-create/link/advance, streamlined UI with centered detail modal, composer chip navigation fix, new task-link/unlink/focus tools, session.read + ui.hostActions capabilities
